tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search SaaSOffers' catalogue of verified startup deals, discounts and credits (Notion, AWS, HubSpot, Stripe and 490+ more). Use it when someone asks for a discount, coupon, free credits or startup program for a software tool, or for deals in a category. Returns each deal's offer, estimated savings and a link to claim it.

query.description: Tool name or need, e.g. "notion", "cloud hosting", "email marketing".

access.description: free: claim with a free account; premium: needs SaaSOffers Premium; apply: vendor reviews eligibility.

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Full details for one SaaSOffers deal by slug (from search_deals): the offer, who is eligible, expiry and how to claim it.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The SaaSOffers deal categories with how many live deals each has.
